svg.title: Switch platforms or end access and services
svg.desc: Check what the customer wants to change, who can approve it, and how new and earlier invoices will be handled.
svg.text: Switch platforms or end access and services
Check what the customer wants to change, who can approve it, and how new and earlier invoices will be handled.
Proposed design · Solid: planned offboarding / shared controls · Dashed: switch, exception or recovery
A change can affect part or all of the setup. Business closure and urgent incidents need different checks.

svg.text: If a switch or exit is requested
Act before setup or handover if access is unsafe
Otherwise, continue the incident recovery work.
Sage coordinates both paths behind one Switch platform request.
New platform not ready? Hold the switch.
Closure evidence missing? Hold the exit.
Only an authorised incident responder may stop unsafe access. This does not complete a switch or customer exit.
Every path keeps evidence and names who will finish earlier work. SPEC032 §1 defines customer scenarios OFF-S01–10.
A listed scenario does not confirm feature availability. Private-to-private switching remains disabled in current onboarding scope.
